name: qbot
description: Chatbot du lịch Quảng Ninh. Chạy toàn bộ stack: pnpm dev

scripts.dev: concurrently -n be,fe,dash -c cyan,green,magenta "pnpm dev:be" "pnpm dev:fe" "pnpm dev:dash"
scripts.infra: docker compose up -d postgres mysql mongo ai legacy
scripts.db: docker compose up -d postgres mysql mongo
scripts.setup: pnpm -C be install && pnpm -C fe install && pnpm -C Dashboard install
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -C be typecheck && pnpm -C fe typecheck && pnpm -C Dashboard typecheck
scripts.build: pnpm -C be build && pnpm -C fe build && pnpm -C Dashboard build
